data.narrative:
Code Metal, a Series B defense and security company founded by Peter Morales and Alex Showalter-Bucher, is valued at $1.25B post-money and has raised $161M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 10 companies—two public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private firms—all operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage transitions, yielding $2.4B. Peer-median methodology identified seven same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B; the median of this peer set stands at $1.0B. Notable peers in this universe include Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), and Harmattan AI ($1.4B).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $1.7B. Code Metal's current $1.25B valuation sits below the median but above the peer median of $1.0B, reflecting its stage positioning relative to the broader cohort. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency metrics relative to peers and near-term revenue trajectory, both of which would inform whether the company tracks toward the upper or lower quartile of this range at Series C.
